targets.authors: LaVigna, G. W., Christian, L., & Willis, T. J.
targets.title: Developing behavioural services to meet defined standards within a national system of specialist educational services.
targets.evidence_quote: LaVigna, Christian, and Willis (2005) reported on a project where Institute for Applied Behaviour Analysis (IABA) staff trained a professional team in New Zealand (NZ) to provide behavioural services that met defined criteria. The NZ team was then trained to train other practitioners to meet the same professional standards. However, no client outcomes were reported in that study. Method This study replicates the NZ study within disability services in Tasmania, Australia.
targets.outcome_quote: The high level of interrater reliability achieved by LaVigna et al. (2005) was replicated and maintained in this study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The training standards, interrater reliability and social validity are explicitly compared with the cited original and treated as replicated; new client outcomes extend it.

reasoning: New trainees and clients test the published training result. Other references motivate the intervention but are not separately retested.
